name: Ego4D Audio-Visual Diarization Challenge 2022
description: This report describes our approach for the Audio-Visual Diarization (AVD) task of the Ego4D Challenge 2022. Specifically, we present multiple technical improvements over the official baselines. First, we improve the detection performance of the camera wearer's voice activity by modifying the training scheme of its model. Second, we discover that an off-the-shelf voice activity detection model can effectively remove false positives when it is applied solely to the camera wearer's voice activities. Lastly, we show that better active speaker detection leads to a better AVD outcome. Our final method obtains 65.9% DER on the test set of Ego4D, which significantly outperforms all the baselines. Our submission achieved 1st place in the Ego4D Challenge 2022.
reputation: A niche challenge benchmark from Ego4D that is mainly used in embodied AI and audio-visual diarization research rather than broad general-purpose evaluation.
notes: Small challenge benchmark with limited public adoption; performance is reported as diarization error rate, so lower is better.
